subject: Contract rollover & capacity scale — proposal and SLA carveout request
messages:
From: Jenna Roberts <jenna@acmehealth.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract rollover & capacity increase for Q4

Hi Sergio / Marissa —

As we discussed on the call, Acme's contract with Redwood rolls over at the end of September. Usage forecasts for our chat endpoints spike in Q4 — we need to move from the current 80 reserved GPUs to 120 (peak sustained throughput target ~2.2M tokens/day). Procurement asked me to formalize capacity and SLA asks so legal can scope the PO.

Key asks from our side:
- Add +40 GPUs to the dedicated pool for the term start (target 2026-10-01).
- 99th-percentile latency target for generation endpoints at <= 450ms for 8k context models.
- If the 99p is missed for more than two windows in a quarter, we expect an uptime/latency credit schedule in the contract.

I'm attaching the procurement spreadsheet with forecasted token volumes and required start date. We'd like to get an indicative cost and any exceptions you need on SLA language by the end of next week so we can get to legal.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

— Jenna
Jenna Roberts
Head of Platform Ops, Acme Health

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ACME capacity + SLA carveout (draft pricing)

Sergio / Neha — pulling together numbers and language. Summary below (draft):

- Capacity change: +40 GPUs (reserved pool increase from 80 -> 120). Estimated incremental monthly commit: $132k (on-demand-equivalent pricing removed, this is reserved-discounted rate).
- Term: 12 months (start 2026-10-01).
- Throughput guarantee: target sustained throughput 2.2M tokens/day.
- SLA carveout (draft): for the first 90 days post-rollout we propose a staged latency target: 99p <= 700ms for first 30 days, 99p <= 550ms for days 31-90; full 99p <= 450ms thereafter. If 99p misses beyond the staged window, credit schedule: 5% monthly credit for single-quarter miss, 10% for two-quarter miss, escalates to termination right after three consecutive quarters of missed SLOs.

Rationale: large capacity scale during a term rollover has higher operational risk; staged SLOs let infra warm caches and tune batching without leaving Acme unprotected by credits.

Attached: redwood-dedicated-quote-v2.pdf (pricing) and sla-carveout-draft.docx (wording).

Thoughts: we should surface this to legal and solutions engineering; also confirm region requirement (us-west-2). If Acme insists on hard 450ms day-one, we'd need a premium uplift (~+22%) to reserve burst capacity and dedicated NVLink placement.

— Marissa
VP, Redwood Dedicated Sales

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Jenna Roberts <jenna@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: rollover + capacity increase (incl. temporary SLA adjustment)

Hi Jenna — attaching a concise proposal based on your ask and our internal review. High level:

1) Capacity: Redwood will add +40 reserved GPUs to Acme's Dedicated pool effective 2026-10-01. This scales your reserved capacity to 120 GPUs.
2) Commercials: incremental monthly commit estimated at $132,000; full quote attached (redwood-dedicated-quote-v2.pdf).
3) SLA / carveout: to balance operational risk during the large scale-up we propose a 90-day staged latency ramp: 99p <= 700ms (day 1–30); 99p <= 550ms (day 31–90); full 99p <= 450ms thereafter. If 99p misses beyond the staged window, credits per quarter apply (5% / 10% / termination right after repeated misses). The carveout is limited to the initial 90-day ramp and documented in the contract as an exception. Draft language is attached (sla-carveout-draft.docx).

If Acme requires an unconditional 99p <= 450ms from day one, we can provide it but would need a one-time engineering uplift + placement fee (estimated +22% to the incremental commit) and a committed burst pool. Please let us know which path Acme prefers so we can hand to legal and spin the PO.

Next steps:
- Approval on staged SLA carveout OR confirmation to price immediate hard SLO.
- Confirm region requirement (us-west-2 or multi-region).
- If approved, legal will receive the redlineable doc and we will target a signature by 2026-08-15 to meet the Oct 1 start.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through the carveout and credits schedule.

Best regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec — Enterprise Healthcare
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-dedicated-quote-v2.pdf (pdf, 84KB); sla-carveout-draft.docx (docx, 14KB)
